card.name: Formulation or route qualifiers before drug names
card.fires_on: The word that qualifies a drug, such as release after immediate, or systemic and oral before corticosteroid or a drug name. It fires in dosing and drug-interaction text.

modes.label: Immediate-release
modes.description: The word release (or -release) right after immediate, in switching or formulation statements.
modes.example: Following a switch from metformin HCl immediate<<-release>> to saxagliptin and metform

modes.label: Systemic or oral qualifier
modes.description: The word systemic or oral just before corticosteroid or a drug name.
modes.example: Co-administration of PREZISTA/ritonavir with systemic dexamethasone or other<< systemic>> corticosteroids that induce CYP

card.plain: It lights up on words like release, systemic or oral that say which form or route of a drug is meant.
